docs.t: HUDs DOWN — what does it trigger?
docs.x: HUDs DOWN — what does it trigger? Preflight Checklist Gate-to-takeoff trigger map (Charlie Morris whiteboard): HUDs Down → “Preflight Checklist.” CA commands, FO reads Phase Triggers

docs.t: Ground call “Circle check complete” — what does it trigger?
docs.x: Ground call “Circle check complete” — what does it trigger? Before Start Checklist Trigger map: ground call (walk-around / circle check complete) → before-start flows → Before Start Checklist → clearance to push (F-C-C: Flows, Checklist, Clearance). CA calls, FO reads Phase Triggers

docs.t: Before Start Checklist complete — what comes next?
docs.x: Before Start Checklist complete — what comes next? Push clearance Trigger map F-C-C: Flows → Checklist → Clearance to push. FCOM assigns no role to pushback clearance. FO obtains departure clearance; CA obtains start clearance + ground comms. Phase Triggers

docs.t: Pin and salute — what does it trigger?
docs.x: Pin and salute — what does it trigger? Before Taxi flow (5 items) → Before Taxi Checklist Trigger map: pushback salute / taxi light → Before Taxi flow → “Before Taxi Checklist.” Flow split CA/FO (item tags below). Checklist: CA calls, FO reads. Phase Triggers

docs.t: Recite the 5 Before Taxi flow items
docs.x: Recite the 5 Before Taxi flow items 1 Flaps · 2 Weather · 3 EICAS swap · 4 Control check · 5 Recall Ryan's trigger list: flaps, weather, EICAS swap, control check, recall. Checklist items behind them: anti-ice, recall, autobrake RTO, flight controls, ground personnel clear (phase_flows, FCOM NP.21). Split CA/FO. See item tags. Phase Triggers

docs.t: Before Taxi Checklist complete — the next two actions?
docs.x: Before Taxi Checklist complete — the next two actions? PM transfer of controls · Taxi clearance Ryan's trigger list: Before Taxi Checklist → PM transfer of controls and taxi clearance. CA/FO → PF/PM transition happens here. Taxi clearance: PM. Phase Triggers

docs.t: FA chime — what does it trigger?
docs.x: FA chime — what does it trigger? Before Takeoff Checklist — read to “Checklist Complete” (mandatory) Trigger map: cabin ready → “Before Takeoff Checklist” → FLY! Before Takeoff is one of only two checklists that must be read through the “Checklist Complete” response (company SOP, class notes). PF calls, PM reads Phase Triggers

docs.t: Line Up and Wait — the 2 items?
docs.x: Line Up and Wait — the 2 items? TA/RA · say “Runway XX confirmed” Ryan's trigger list: LUAW → transponder TA/RA, verbal runway confirmation. PM sets TA/RA. Both pilots call “Runway confirmed.” Phase Triggers

docs.t: Flaps up after takeoff — 3 items, then what?
docs.x: Flaps up after takeoff — 3 items, then what? Nose light OFF · Taxi light OFF · Anti-ice AUTO → After Takeoff Checklist Ryan's trigger list: after-takeoff flaps up → nose and taxi lights OFF, anti-ice AUTO → After Takeoff Checklist (FCOM NP.21.35: After Takeoff checklist after flap retraction). PM does the 3 items. Checklist: PF calls, PM reads. Phase Triggers

docs.t: Climbing through 10,000 ft — the 4 items?
docs.x: Climbing through 10,000 ft — the 4 items? Chime twice · Landing lights OFF · RWY turnoff lights OFF · WING light OFF Ryan's trigger list, matching the 3 vetted 10,000-ft steps in the Flows Trainer plus the double chime. PM Phase Triggers

docs.t: Clearing the runway after landing — first action, then what?
docs.x: Clearing the runway after landing — first action, then what? Speedbrake DOWN → After Landing flow (7 items) Ryan's trigger list: clear of the runway → speedbrake DOWN is the trigger for the After Landing flow. CA: speedbrake DOWN. PM: the 7-item flow (WX radar OFF = PF). Phase Triggers

docs.t: Recite the 7 After Landing flow items
docs.x: Recite the 7 After Landing flow items 1 APU start · 2 Anti-ice · 3 WX radar OFF · 4 Autobrake OFF · 5 Flaps UP · 6 Transponder · 7 Arrival report Ryan's trigger list: APU start, anti-ice, weather radar off, autobrake off, flaps up, transponder, arrival report. PM. WX radar OFF is PF. Phase Triggers

docs.t: Reverse: what trigger kicks off the Before Taxi flow?
docs.x: Reverse: what trigger kicks off the Before Taxi flow? Pin and salute Trigger map: pushback salute / taxi light → Before Taxi flow. Event trigger, not a crew task Phase Triggers

docs.t: Reverse: what trigger calls for the Before Takeoff Checklist?
docs.x: Reverse: what trigger calls for the Before Takeoff Checklist? FA chime (cabin ready) Trigger map: cabin ready → Before Takeoff Checklist. Event trigger, not a crew task Phase Triggers

docs.t: Reverse: what trigger calls for the Preflight Checklist?
docs.x: Reverse: what trigger calls for the Preflight Checklist? HUDs down Trigger map: HUDs Down → Preflight Checklist. Event trigger, not a crew task Phase Triggers

docs.t: Reverse: what is the trigger for the After Landing flow?
docs.x: Reverse: what is the trigger for the After Landing flow? Clear of the runway → Speedbrake DOWN Ryan's trigger list: clearing the runway, speedbrake lever down, then the 7-item flow. CA. Speedbrake DOWN. Phase Triggers

docs.t: The gouge before the Descent Checklist — recite the 6 items
docs.x: The gouge before the Descent Checklist — recite the 6 items ATIS · Build · Bug · Brakes · Brief · RNP/Recall Ryan's descent/approach-setup gouge (6 items, updated Jul 2026): ATIS, Build (the approach in the FMC), Bug (speeds/minimums), Brakes (autobrake), Brief, RNP/Recall. Supersedes the earlier 5-step ATIS/Build/Bug/Brief/Brakes version. Approach Setup

docs.t: Descent gouge: what comes after Build?
docs.x: Descent gouge: what comes after Build? Bug ATIS → Build → Bug → Brakes → Brief → RNP/Recall. Approach Setup

docs.t: Descent gouge: first item and last item?
docs.x: Descent gouge: first item and last item? ATIS first · RNP/Recall last ATIS → Build → Bug → Brakes → Brief → RNP/Recall. Approach Setup

docs.t: Mandatory brief item for a LOW-LEVEL go-around?
docs.x: Mandatory brief item for a LOW-LEVEL go-around? “I will guard the throttles forward and call ‘Set Thrust’ — PM verifies thrust is set” FCOM NP.21.51 WARNING: TO/GA function is inhibited close to the ground and after touchdown. If the thrust levers do not respond when TO/GA is pushed, or if the go-around is initiated after touchdown, advance the thrust levers manually to go-around thrust. Go-Around Brief

docs.t: Why must thrust be advanced manually on a low-level go-around?
docs.x: Why must thrust be advanced manually on a low-level go-around? TO/GA is inhibited close to the ground and after touchdown FCOM NP.21.51 WARNING: TO/GA function is inhibited close to the ground and after touchdown. Go-Around Brief

docs.t: Low-level go-around: PM's job after “Set Thrust”?
docs.x: Low-level go-around: PM's job after “Set Thrust”? Verify go-around thrust is set — call “Thrust Set” Go-around procedure: PM sets flaps as directed and verifies thrust, calling “Thrust Set” (FCOM NP.21.51 / phase flows). Go-Around Brief

docs.t: Recite all 10 normal checklists in order
docs.x: Recite all 10 normal checklists in order Preflight · Before Start · Before Taxi · Before Takeoff · After Takeoff · Descent · Approach · Landing · Shutdown · Secure FCOM NP normal procedures sequence, as laid out gate to gate in the Phase Flows page. Checklist Order

docs.t: First 5 checklists, in order?
docs.x: First 5 checklists, in order? Preflight · Before Start · Before Taxi · Before Takeoff · After Takeoff Ground and takeoff phase checklists. Checklist Order

docs.t: Last 5 checklists, in order?
docs.x: Last 5 checklists, in order? Descent · Approach · Landing · Shutdown · Secure Arrival and termination phase checklists. Checklist Order

docs.t: Which checklist follows Before Taxi?
docs.x: Which checklist follows Before Taxi? Before Takeoff … Before Taxi → Before Takeoff → After Takeoff … Checklist Order

docs.t: Which checklist follows After Takeoff?
docs.x: Which checklist follows After Takeoff? Descent No cruise checklist: After Takeoff → Descent. Checklist Order

docs.t: Which checklist follows Approach?
docs.x: Which checklist follows Approach? Landing … Descent → Approach → Landing … Checklist Order

docs.t: Which checklist follows Landing?
docs.x: Which checklist follows Landing? Shutdown … Landing → Shutdown → Secure. Checklist Order

docs.t: Which TWO checklists must be read through “Checklist Complete”?
docs.x: Which TWO checklists must be read through “Checklist Complete”? Before Takeoff and Landing — mandatory Company SOP per class notes: only the Before Takeoff and Landing checklists require the verbal “Checklist Complete” response, and it is mandatory for both. Checklist Order
